description: This file defines the ResourceIdentifier class, which implements interfaces for JSON API resource identification, including properties for id, type, and meta, and methods for serialization and configuration.

classes.name: ResourceIdentifier
classes.description: A class representing a JSON API resource identifier with properties for id, type, and meta, implementing interfaces for response formatting and logging.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Sets the id property and returns a clone of the object.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Sets the type property and returns a clone of the object.

methods.name: withMeta
methods.description: Sets the meta data and returns a clone of the object.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Assigns a logger instance to the object.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Serializes the resource identifier to a JSON API response array.
